questions.text: Outline any concerns regarding the impact of the JV on competition in Australia, including if UPM and Sappi are close competitors and there are not many alternatives or if one is a major supplier to competitors of the other.
Provide any additional information or comments that you consider relevant to the ACCC’s assessment of the JV.
Provide a brief description of your business or organisation, including any commercial relationships with UPM and/or Sappi.
